ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: After ignoring all curved arrows, on the left side of the figure is a carbonyl O=C; the carbonyl carbon is connected to R1 and connected to an adjacent carbon; this adjacent carbon is connected to R2 and continues to connect to the central carbon on the right side. The central carbon is connected to an oxygen [O-] with a negative charge above, an oxygen in an OR group, an N-OH group, and is connected to the adjacent carbon on the left. Reasoning: According to the method, convert R, R1, and R2 all into the wildcard *. Starting from the OR oxygen, write *O, then connect the central carbon C. The central carbon has two branches: [O-] and NO; the main chain continues to the carbon C(*) bearing R2, then to the carbonyl carbon C(*)=O bearing R1. Therefore the SMILES is *OC([O-])(NO)C(*)C(*)=O.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe only the static connectivity in the image, ignoring all curved arrows. Convert each R label (R, R1, R2) into a wildcard '*' atom. Choose the OR oxygen as the starting point, writing *O- attached to the central carbon. For the central carbon, add branches for the negatively charged oxygen [O-] and the N-OH group as NO, then continue to the adjacent carbon bearing R2 and finally to the carbonyl carbon bearing R1. This yields the SMILES '*OC([O-])(NO)C(*)C(*)=O'.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：忽略所有弯箭头后，图中左侧是羰基 O=C，羰基碳连接 R1，并连接到相邻碳；该相邻碳连接 R2，并继续连接到右侧中心碳。中心碳连接一个上方带负电的氧 [O-]、一个 OR 基团中的氧、一个 N-OH 基团，并与左侧相邻碳相连。推理：按方法将 R、R1、R2 都转换为通配符 *。从 OR 氧开始写作 *O，再连接中心碳 C。中心碳有两个分支：[O-] 和 NO；主链继续到带 R2 的碳 C(*)，再到带 R1 的羰基碳 C(*)=O。因此 SMILES 为 *OC([O-])(NO)C(*)C(*)=O。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-to-SMILES transcription route; it relies on identifying each atom/bond in the drawn transition-state structure and converting substituent labels to wildcards. Since the task asks for one SMILES, no alternative genuinely different route is needed.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the molecular drawing: a left carbonyl C=O bearing R1 and bonded to an adjacent carbon bearing R2; that adjacent carbon is bonded to a central carbon. The central carbon is bonded to an oxyanion O−, to an OR group through oxygen, and to an N bearing H and OH. Curved arrows are present but must be ignored.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R groups as wildcard atoms '*'; encode carbonyl as C(*)=O, oxyanion as [O-], hydroxylamine substituent as NO when attached through N, and branch substituents with parentheses around the central carbon connectivity. Ignore transition-state arrows and stereochemical/3D implications unless explicitly encoded.
